Author: Anomek, Noir Yamato
Name: NoirMech
Punchline: AnoMech with LPDU strats for TOP P2, P3, P4 and P5 Delta, and a pause. Go to an inn and start practice.
Description: A modified version of AnoMech by Anomek (https://github.com/anomek/AnoMech) that adds EU LPDU strats for TOP P2 Party Synergy, TOP P3 Intermission, P3 Hello World, P3 Monitors, P4 Blue Screen and P5 Delta, and a pause for studying mechanics mid-run. Spawns fake party members and bosses client-side so you can practice raid mechanics without a full party. Disable AnoMech while using NoirMech. Source: https://github.com/NoirYamato/DalamudPlugins
Changelog: TOP P5 Delta: an [LPDU] Light PF strat under the EU button, now the default, with automarkers (a triangle on Near World, a cross on Distant World), and the eye can now spawn on any cardinal. TOP P3 Monitors: automarkers (Bind 1-3 on the monitor players, Attack 1-5 on everyone else). In multiplayer Delta, tether, monitor and Hello World choices are honoured more reliably.
